correctness.rationale: PASS. Exhaustively classify closed factors by 0,1,2 marker occurrences and number of internal proper-border occurrences. Closed palindromes contribute exactly n; other closed factors have two markers and unequal outer gaps i!=j with i<=min(a,b),j<=min(b,c), giving max(A,B)(min(A,B)+1). Optimization over p<=q, p+2q<=n-2 gives exact 3-residue piecewise maxima and complete maximizing gap triples. The simplex Riemann integral gives mean n²/36+O(n). Independently brute-enumerated the entire set of distinct closed factors for all 680 words length 2..16 with exactly two 1s; verified boundary n=2,3 and maximizing tuples. This finite test alone would not establish all lengths, which use the factor argument.
residual_risks: Definition excludes empty word; standard literature often counts it, shifting all totals by one.
